name_zh: 萨米议会/驯鹿游牧领袖：萨米协商制与驯鹿游牧自治
name_en: Sami Parliament/Reindeer Herding Leaders: Sami Consultative Governance & Reindeer Pastoral Autonomy
description_zh: 萨米议会 (Sámediggi) 1989 年在挪威成立，1993 瑞典、1996 芬兰跟进，是跨国原住民主权的先锋实验。核心治理机制：廷特 (Tingt) 协商会议制——村落代表通过共识决策放牧区轮牧/捕鱼配额/矿业协商；约伊克 (Joik) 口述传统编码生态知识；驯鹿放牧区 (Sameby) 集体所有制与轮牧制度。萨米议会虽无立法权，但拥有咨询权/否决权/预算权，强制国家在采矿/风电/铁路项目上进行自由事先知情同意 (FPIC)。体现 M176 萨米协商制——以"跨国议会+驯鹿游牧生计+约伊克知识编码"三位一体，在现代国家体系中实现原住民主权的制度化突围。
description_en: Sami Parliament (Sámediggi) founded 1989 Norway, 1993 Sweden, 1996 Finland, pioneering transnational indigenous sovereignty experiment. Core governance mechanism: Tingt consultative councils—village representatives decide by consensus on grazing rotation/fishing quotas/mining negotiations; Joik oral tradition encodes ecological knowledge; reindeer grazing districts (Sameby) collective ownership with rotational grazing. Parliament lacks legislative power but holds consultation/veto/budget rights, forcing states to FPIC on mining/wind/rail projects. Exemplifies M176 Sami Consultative Governance—trinity of 'transnational parliament + reindeer pastoral livelihood + Joik knowledge encoding' achieving institutionalized indigenous sovereignty breakthrough in modern state system.
reason_zh: 萨米人跨挪/瑞/芬/俄四国，无主权国家却拥有跨国议会，是"无国籍族群的议会制自治"独特范式。M176 区隔于 M148 毛利共识(新西兰单一)、M177 因纽特(北美/格陵兰)、M178 极地气候(工程)，核心在于"跨国议会制+游牧生计即主权基础+口述传统编码生态法"。
reason_en: Sami across Norway/Sweden/Finland/Russia four states, no sovereign nation yet possess transnational parliament—unique paradigm of 'stateless nation parliamentary autonomy'. M176 distinct from M148 Māori Consensus (NZ single), M177 Inuit (NA/Greenland), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), core: 'transnational parliamentary system + pastoral livelihood as sovereignty base + oral tradition encoding ecological law'.
steps_zh: 萨米议会选举与跨国协调：四国议会各自选举、萨米议会会议协调共同立场，跨国族群民主实验
廷特协商决策制：村落代表共识决策放牧/捕鱼/狩猎/矿业，无投票仅共识，少数意见保护机制
驯鹿放牧区轮牧管理：Sameby 集体所有、季节性迁徙路线/围栏/补充喂养协商，生计即治理单元
约伊克口述传承生态法：约伊克旋律编码动物迁徙/植物物候/冰雪状况，长老传承非书面生态法律
FPIC 强制咨询权：风电/铁路/矿业项目强制萨米议会同意，绿色殖民抵抗与利益分享谈判
steps_en: Sami Parliament elections & transnational coordination: four national parliaments elected separately, Sami Parliamentary Conference coordinates common positions, transnational ethnic democracy experiment
Tingt consultative decision-making: village representatives consensus on grazing/fishing/hunting/mining, no voting only consensus, minority opinion protection
Reindeer grazing district rotational management: Sameby collective ownership, seasonal migration routes/fencing/supplementary feeding negotiated, livelihood as governance unit
Joik oral transmission of ecological law: Joik melodies encode animal migration/plant phenology/ice conditions, elder transmission of non-written ecological law
FPIC mandatory consultation: wind/rail/mining projects require Sami Parliament consent, green colonialism resistance & benefit-sharing negotiation
expected_zh: 无主权原住民族以"跨国议会+游牧生计+口述生态法"三位一体，在现代国家体系中实现制度化自治，为全球原住民自治提供跨国范式。
expected_en: Stateless indigenous nation achieves institutionalized autonomy via trinity of 'transnational parliament + pastoral livelihood + oral ecological law', providing transnational paradigm for global indigenous self-governance.
